description: Returns one county's published venue facts by state code and county slug: population and demographics, economy, elections and courts, each source dated. Use this when the user asks about one specific county as a venue. Not for case, juror or client data, and not legal advice: it returns published venue facts only.

county.description: The county slug from venues_list for that state, e.g. 'acadia'.
county.title: County
